spec_references: Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
reason: The negative test asserts diagnostics for structured error match patterns, including reason/detail captures and rest captures. These patterns are outside the explicitly supported match-pattern forms, so their diagnostic behavior is outside subset 10.
